title: Global Markets: Hotter Europe isn't cooling investor fervor for stocks
description: The heatwaves pummelling Europe this summer will have costly impacts on industries ranging from agriculture to tourism -- but that hasn't stopped stock markets from hitting all-time highs. The Paris, Frankfurt, Madrid and Milan exchanges all hit records in August, in line with recent all-time highs for Wall Street's key indexes.

title: Accel India IV offloads 1.3 pc stake in Urban Company
description: Accel India IV has completed the sale of a 1.3 percent stake in Urban Company as of August 13, 2026. The Mauritius-based investor offloaded 2 crore equity shares via open market deals, trimming its stake to 4.84 percent. Urban Company stands out with a total equity share capital exceeding 154 crore shares, further emphasizing its scale in the home services market.

title: Pernia's Pop-Up Shop likely to launch Rs 660 crore IPO by Aug-end
description: Purple Style Labs is set to launch its initial public offering (IPO) at an impressive Rs 660 crore by the end of August. Having received the green light from Sebi for its entry into the public market, the luxury fashion label aims to channel the proceeds into expansion and support for its retail arm.

title: Ashok Leyland Q1 profit rises 2% as revenue jumps 10% to Rs 10,750 crore
description: Ashok Leyland reported a 2% rise in consolidated Q1FY27 profit to ₹668 crore, while revenue grew 10% to ₹10,750 crore. Record commercial vehicle sales supported performance, though rising material costs pressured margins, prompting cost-saving and pricing initiatives.

title: Sebi proposes to rationalise penalties for settling ongoing cases
description: India's market regulator has introduced an updated framework for addressing securities law violations, designed to streamline processes and decrease litigation. This proposed method may lead to reduced average settlement amounts for infractions. Individuals who faced prior rejections can submit new applications with modified terms. Stakeholders are encouraged to share their feedback on these proposals by September 4, 2026.

title: Sebi mulls digital onboarding for individual foreign investors to boost participation in securities mkt
description: Sebi has put forth a proposal for the digital onboarding of individual foreign investors, aimed at enhancing their access to markets. Intermediaries could utilize video verification for clients based abroad. Additionally, the framework suggests accepting KYC from other Sebi-registered entities. This initiative targets clients in FATF-compliant countries, with public feedback on the proposal requested by September 4.

title: WeWork Global sells 2.5% stake in WeWork India Management for Rs 244 crore
description: WeWork Global has divested a 2.5% stake in WeWork India for Rs 244 crore, bringing its ownership down to 12.3% from 14.82%. Despite this stake reduction, WeWork India reported a consolidated net loss of Rs 4.30 crore for the first quarter while witnessing a total income increase to Rs 700.74 crore during the April-June period. The venture originated as a partnership between WeWork Global and Embassy Group.

title: Sebi broadens scope of online bond platforms, permits IFSCA-regulated products and tax-saving bonds
description: SEBI has expanded the scope for Online Bond Platform Providers (OBPPs), allowing them to offer IFSCA-regulated products and specific tax-saving bonds.
